text:
marta: quick sync — planning a canary for the new kernel/optimizations combo tomorrow 09:00 UTC. targets: speculative_decode_v3 + flash-attn-tuned + kv_partial_eviction. who can own runbook + alerts?

alex: I can take runbook. quick Q: audience scope? internal only, partial prod, or subset of customers?

marta: start internal (eng + beta) for 1h, then 3% prod for 2h, ramp to 10% if stable. rollback if latency regresses >10ms p50 or error rate >0.1%. also immediate fallback to kernel-v2 on failure.

jin: heads-up — kv_partial_eviction changes memory churn; we should watch GPU mem spikes and OOMs. I'll add a memory gauge to dashboards.

sam: I'll create alerts:
- latency_regress: query avg(latency) - baseline > 10ms for 3m -> paging
- error_rate: request_errors / requests > 0.001 for 5m -> non-paging but slack notify
- gpu_mem_spike: 95p mem > baseline*1.2 for 2m -> paging

alex: adding these guardrails to runbook. also include quick curl to flip flag for partial rollouts:```bash
# canary flip example
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/redwood/toggle 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"flag": "speculative_decode_v3", "state": "partial", "pct": 3}'
```

marta: perfect. @tara pls be oncall for the 09:00 canary window? will ping if anything noisy.

tara: can do. will be around 08:30-11:30 UTC. please add me to the incident channel and tag me in alerts. :thumbsup:

jin: quick code-review ping — I opened PR #4821 for the kv eviction guard. cc @alex for kernel hook review. small change, mostly tests + telemetry.

alex: ack, will review before EOD. can you add a non-regression unit that simulates short sequences (seq len 64) + long sequences (seq len 2048)? previous bug showed degradation only on mid-long tails.

jin: added tests and a stress script in the PR. also added a small logging tag `kernel_opt=spec_v3` so we can filter traces.

sam: deploy-bot will post here when canary starts. I made a dashboard snapshot and pinned it to the runbook. link: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/kernel-canary

deploy-bot: deploy started: kernel-opt/spec_v3 -> canary slot 12 (3% prod + internal). build 2026.03.17-8f2a

marta: reminder: keep messages short in runbook, step numbers, rollback criteria, and contact list. we'll use conversation as async takeaways if anything changes.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: canary active on slot 12. health checks initial pass.

tara: seeing a small rise in p50 (~6ms) but within threshold. monitoring.

alex: if p50 grows >10ms I want automatic fallback. add this to the flag config: `auto_fallback_on_latency=true`.

sam: added alert action to trigger flag flip and post to #incidents if latency breach persists for 3m.

jin: FYI the kv eviction metric spiked briefly at +18% then normalized. no OOMs. adding a longer tail test to perf harness.

marta: excellent. after 2h stable at 3% we can discuss ramp plan to 10% (ops + customer success notified). I'll post final status here.

alex: thanks everyone. ping me if PR blocks rollout.

marta: <@tara> thanks for being oncall. will update thread after the ramp decision. :rocket:
